subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

The reports of the medical tests done are now __accessible__ on phone.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"accessible"** means something that can be easily reached, entered, or used. (सुगम)

 
 
• **Example: **The library is **accessible** to all students.
 
 
 
• **"Restricted" **refers to something that is limited or controlled, and not freely available. (प्रतिबंधित)
 
 
• **Example: **Access to the confidential files is** restricted **to senior management only.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'accessible' **is **'restricted'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Useless **(बेकार): Not fulfilling or not expected to achieve the intended purpose.

 
 
• **Example:** The broken machine is useless.
 
 
 
• **Free **(मुफ्त): Not under the control or in the power of another; able to act or be done as one wishes.
 
 
• **Example: **The service is free for all users.
 
 
 
• **Invisible** (अदृश्य): Unable to be seen; not visible to the eye.
 
 
• **Example:** The stars are invisible during the day.
